title: Director of Revenue Enablement
description:
Impartner is a global leader in the channel management sector, and we are looking for growth-minded thought leaders to PARTNER with us! Our company is #1 in our space and is accelerating away from the pack. We’re winning, and we’re having fun doing it.
 We’re looking for an experienced, credible Director of Revenue Enablement to partner directly with our Chief Revenue Officer on how our revenue team sells. You’ll own the process, training, playbooks and messaging that help every rep, SE and partner manager win more consistently.
 The CRO leads and manages the sales team directly. You’ll be the force multiplier beside them: turning strategy into repeatable process, turning positioning into talk tracks reps actually use, and running role plays and call reviews. You’ll also serve as the CRO’s right hand on the revenue operating rhythm, making sure cross-functional initiatives across Sales, Marketing and Product land on time. This is not a people-management role and not a Salesforce admin role. You’ll define how we sell and make sure the team is ready to do it.
 Impartner is changing the way companies think about and run business in partner-driven ecosystems, and your work will help our revenue team deliver that value to customers.
 At Impartner , this means you will: 
 Support New Logo Representatives, Account Executives, Solution Engineers, and our Partner and Distribution (Disti) teams.
 Define and document our sales process, including stage definitions, exit criteria and deal inspection standards
 Design clean handoffs across new logo AEs, upsell AEs, SEs and partner teams
 Write the requirements for how our process shows up in Salesforce, and partner with RevOps/admin resources to build it
 Build and run a structured onboarding and ramp program for new AEs, SEs and partner managers
 Deliver ongoing skills training on discovery, value selling, negotiation and our PRM platform story
 Create certifications that confirm reps are ready on core pitches, demos and plays
 Run regular role plays, mock calls and deal simulations with individual reps and the team
 Use Gong to review calls, spot skill gaps and winning patterns, and turn those findings into training
 Reinforce the coaching the CRO gives in 1:1s so improvement sticks
 Own the sales playbook: personas, discovery guides, objection handling, competitive battlecards, and email and call templates
 Maintain a single, organized source of truth that is easy for reps to find and use in the moment, and keep it current as our product, market and competitors change
 Translate Marketing positioning and campaigns into field-ready talk tracks, decks and plays
 Bring structured feedback from the field back to Marketing and Product: what resonates, what loses deals, what customers ask for
 Help the team stay focused on priority segments, plays and partner motions each quarter
 Run the revenue team operating cadence, including team meetings, QBR prep and initiative tracking
 Drive cross-team launches (pricing, packaging, product releases) so Sales is ready on day one
 Follow through on decisions and action items across Sales, Marketing, Product, CS and Finance so initiatives don’t stall
 Prepare materials for the CRO, including executive and board-level updates as needed
 What success looks like in the first 12 months: 
 Faster time to first deal and full ramp for new AEs
 100% of the team certified on core pitch, demo and plays within 90 days of launch
 Improved win rate, stage-to-stage conversion and pipeline quality
 Consistent role plays and Gong call reviews each month
 Sales-ready materials delivered before every major launch
 80%+ of priority cross-functional initiatives delivered on time
 What we're looking for: 
 Minimum of 5 years in B2B SaaS, with a background as a quota-carrying seller, sales manager or sales enablement leader
 Proven experience building sales process, onboarding programs and playbooks from scratch
 Credibility with reps: you can run a role play, give sharp feedback and demonstrate what good looks like
 Strong program management skills, with the ability to drive initiatives across teams without direct authority
 Excellent writing and presentation skills for both field content and executive communication
 Working knowledge of Salesforce and Gong (or similar conversation intelligence tools)
 Preferred: experience with partner, channel or distribution sales motions
 Preferred: familiarity with the PRM, partner ecosystem or channel software market
 Preferred: experience at a high-growth company during a scaling phase
 Preferred: exposure to sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or Challenger

$140,000 - $170,000 per year base salary, plus a 10% to 20% variable bonus tied to team revenue and initiative goals.

description:
Client Experience Manager
 About Market My Market 
 Market My Market is a fast-growing digital marketing agency delivering customized, full-service marketing campaigns that bring companies to life online. We pride ourselves in delivering measurable results that directly impact our clients' businesses. Our target markets include single event legal, specialty medical, and dental clients located across the country who are looking to grow their presence in their local markets.
 Our Growth Story : In just 4 years, Market My Market has experienced remarkable growth, expanding from 40 clients to nearly 200 clients. This rapid expansion reflects our commitment to excellence and the trust our clients place in our services.

 As a Client Experience Manager (CXM) at Market My Market , you'll serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of 30-40 single-location and small-multi-location service businesses — primarily law firms, specialty medical practices, and dental practices focusing on delivering exceptional account management and fostering long-term client relationships. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

 As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.
 We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

 Role Overview
 As Enterprise Implementation Manager , you will report to the Director of Implementations and own onboarding for PermitFlow ’s strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll lead complex implementations from post-sale handoff through launch, serving as the primary customer contact and driving early value. 
 What You'll Do
 Own enterprise onboarding end to end for strategic PermitFlow accounts - from post-sale handoff through successful launch and transition to Customer Success.

 5+ years of experience leading customer onboarding, implementation, or customer success for B2B SaaS enterprise or strategic accounts.
 Proven ownership of complex implementations, managing multiple stakeholders, cross-functional dependencies, and customer-facing timelines from kickoff to launch.
 Demonstrated ability to drive adoption and time-to-value, including leading live trainings, enablement sessions, and post-launch readiness reviews.
 Strong project management and communication skills, evidenced by successfully running executive-facing meetings, maintaining clear project plans, and resolving risks or blockers proactively
